All notable changes to TrackEdge. Versions follow [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org).

## [1.0.0](https://github.com/apurv-1/trackedge/releases/tag/v1.0.0) - 2026-11-02

### Features

- Bundle the app with a generated icon
- Add menu bar app for volume, brightness, and media edges
- Add edge gesture engine with unit tests
- Add multitouch bridge to read raw trackpad touches

### Documentation

- Add readme, contributing guide, and security policy

### Maintenance

- Add owner-only manual release workflow
- Stamp release versions and support universal builds
- Move actions off the deprecated node 20 runtime
- Build, test, and bundle on macos
- Set up swift package with mit license
